QuestInfo.name: Ayan's Request
QuestInfo.0: You have something you need to tell #p1022007#, who is standing watch by #b#m102000000##k. Go see #b#p1022007##k
QuestInfo.1: #p1022007# says that there are many problems at the moment, so the guards could use some help. Since you look all beefy and heroic, he of course asked you to help. Talk to #b#p1013000##k about it.
QuestInfo.2: #p1013000# says that helping people is always a good thing to do.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary:
2,000 EXP
Can proceed to 'Helping Beginner Adventurers' quest

0.0: Hello, you're Evan right? #p1040000# tells me that you're pretty strong. Are you busy? No no, this has nothing to do with the puppets.
0.1: To tell you the truth, the guards in #m102000000# are always short on help. We wouldn't want to see a talented explorer like you pass by... So, would you like to join the Victoria Guards?
0.2: The work isn't too difficult. We don't want our beginners to get hurt, so you'll just work on supporting roles. What do you say? Would you like to do it?

yes.0: #b(This is sure to interfere with your training. Will #p1013000# agree to do it? Talk to #p1013000#.)#k

no.0: Oh man, rejected just like that... We take a lot of pride in our work, you know. We keep #m102000000# safe, help the helpless, get full medical and 401K...

1.0: What is it, master? What? You're thinking about joining the Guards? What do the Guards do anyway? \r\n#L0##b(You briefly explain the Guard's duties.)#l\n#k
1.1: Oh! Helping people is a good thing! Heroes shouldn't refuse such a request! Training is important but that doesn't mean we should ignore people in need! Great idea! Let's join the Guards!

npc.0: Well... Think about it carefully and let me know whether you want to join the Guards or not.
